source_text: The Ternway R-18 is a self-propelled intercity rail coach configured for regional services. The Regional Comfort version measures 24.5 m long, 3.05 m wide and 4.10 m high. It provides 72 seats and standing room for up to 18 additional passengers. Maximum operating speed is 160 km/h on 1,435 mm gauge track. The vehicle uses diesel-electric traction.
passenger_capacity: 72 seats and standing room for up to 18 additional passengers
